text: Jibriila wi'ani mo: "Fiyaake on ko wano mi jaŋtori non, fii kala gorko meemaali ma wanaa tanaa mun a laataaki kadi jeenoowo, kono Joomi maaɗa Senayee woananii Mo O Daalii: "Tagugol ɓiɗɗo mo alaa baaba no newii e Makko, fii yo ɓiɗɗo mo okkaɗaa on laato maande wonannde yimɓe ɓen e Kattanɗe Alla, e Yurmeende Amen e maaɗa e kala gomɗimɗo mo, Tagugol ɓiɗɗo maa on laatike Ñaawoore immornde ka Alla eɓɓaande, winndaa- nde ka Alluwal Reenaangal".
